Seabreeze | 5 Bluestem Lane | WaterColor, FL

5 Bluestem Lane, Santa Rosa Beach, FL 32459

Welcome to “Seabreeze” located at 5 Bluestem Lane in WaterColor, FL. This 5 bedroom + bunk space, 5 bathroom home (including carriage house) sleeps 14, featuring shiplap walls, hardwood floors, and an open-concept layout, making it ideal for hosting families in comfort and style. This home also includes a golf cart/LSV, 5 beach cruiser bicycles, parking for up to 2 vehicles, and is pet friendly!

The first floor welcomes you to the main living space featuring a bright and open kitchen with granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, and seating for 10 between the breakfast bar and dining table—an ideal setup for family meals and gathering together. Also on this level is the master bedroom with a king bed and a private ensuite bathroom with a tub and shower, and a half bathroom.

On the second floor, you’ll find two beautifully appointed guest bedrooms, each offering a king bed and a private bathroom. This floor also includes a third guest bedroom with a king bed and an ensuite bathroom, and bonus bunk area with two sets of twin-over-twin bunks, perfect for kids or teens. Step outside onto the spacious wraparound balcony and enjoy wooded views, a cozy porch swing, and a screened-in area complete with a ping-pong table. Additionally, there is a TV/game room on this floor.

The carriage house provides even more flexibility, featuring a guest bedroom with a queen bed, a private bathroom with a shower and tub combo, and a convenient kitchenette and living room.

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

- Guests can enjoy complimentary rides anywhere in WaterColor using the on-demand WaterColor Trolley, available through the WaterColor Trolley app in your app store.

- Pet Friendly: Max weight of the dog is 40lbs. You must notify us of the breed and weight of dog. Pet cleaning fee of $250 applies

- No events, such as wedding receptions and other large gatherings are allowed. Only people sleeping in the home are allowed on this property. If violated, double cleaning fees, as well as other possible fees, will apply.

- WaterColor HOA allows one golf cart per address- you may not rent a second cart if the home you have rented offers one. All golf cart rentals in Watercolor must be made through The Electric Cart Company and will be limited to a specific amount throughout the community at any given time. Cart rentals are granted on a first-come, first-served based. Watercolor condos cannot rent golf carts.

- 14 Amenity Wristbands - Maximum. Extras are not available. Access to All WaterColor Community Swimming Pools - Camp WaterColor and the Beach Club.

- The HOA issues one parking pass per reservation. Guests are encouraged to park their vehicles in the driveway or garage of their rental home. They do not need a parking pass when their vehicle is parked on a private residential property.The HOA-issued parking pass is required to park a vehicle overnight on the common area parking pads.

Reservation/Booking Policy

- Minimum age: All properties require a minimum of one adult over the age of 26 be staying at the property throughout the rental term.

- A 50% deposit is due at the time of booking.

- Except for a $250 Cancellation Fee, deposits are fully refundable if cancellations are given 60 days prior to the arrival date.

- Balance of payment is due 60 days prior to the arrival date.

- Check-in begins at 4:00 PM and check-out is by 10:00 AM.

- Cleaning: Reservations made for more than 12 nights require a full clean during your stay. This will be added onto your total when checking out. Reservations for less than 12 days, have the option to add a mid-stay clean onto your reservation.
